scope.note: Extension-only. Extends the existing 'Stroke' disease created by the Neurologic Production Source Manifest v1 (PR #37, merged). Coma is NOT a separate disease -- it already exists inside Stroke as END_STAGE_FINDING concepts ('Coma', 'Persistent Coma', 'Persistent Vegetative State', 'Minimally Conscious State') and as the SEVERITY_CLASS variant 'Stroke With Persistent Coma'. This manifest adds only the small set of universal non-disease-specific hospice-eligibility-support concepts that every other disease foundation already carries but Stroke's foundation never received, links them to the existing 'Stroke With Persistent Coma' variant, links Stroke's existing PPS/KPS 40-percent-threshold concepts to the Functional Assessment Framework, and adds a recertification trend model. No new disease, no new variant, and no new PPS/KPS/ADL scale definitions are created.

already_present_verified.note: Every coma-related and infection/pressure-injury-related item already exists on the Stroke disease under PR #37 and is not duplicated here.

new_concepts.name: ADL Dependence
new_concepts.description: Dependence in most or all activities of daily living is a recognized hospice-support indicator for advanced stroke/coma disease supporting documentation of disease severity and recertification review. Does not independently establish hospice eligibility -- remains dependent upon the complete documented clinical picture and physician-supported determination.

new_concepts.name: Progressive Functional Decline
new_concepts.description: Progressive, longitudinal functional decline is a recognized hospice-support indicator for advanced stroke/coma disease supporting documentation of disease trajectory and recertification review. Does not independently establish hospice eligibility -- remains dependent upon the complete documented clinical picture and physician-supported determination.

new_concepts.name: Progressive Nutritional Decline
new_concepts.description: Progressive, longitudinal nutritional decline is a recognized hospice-support indicator for advanced stroke/coma disease supporting documentation of disease trajectory and recertification review. Does not independently establish hospice eligibility -- remains dependent upon the complete documented clinical picture and physician-supported determination.

functional_assessment_linkage.chf_concept_name: Palliative Performance Scale 40 Percent or Less
functional_assessment_linkage.description: Links Stroke's existing Palliative Performance Scale 40 Percent or Less hospice-eligibility-support concept to the Functional Assessment Framework's PPS scale definition for full nurse-facing score interpretation, without duplicating the scale's level content.

functional_assessment_linkage.chf_concept_name: Karnofsky Performance Status 40 Percent or Less
functional_assessment_linkage.description: Links Stroke's existing Karnofsky Performance Status 40 Percent or Less hospice-eligibility-support concept to the Functional Assessment Framework's KPS scale definition for full nurse-facing score interpretation, without duplicating the scale's level content.

trend_indicators.name: PPS Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current Palliative Performance Scale score, tracked across recertification periods to document functional decline.

trend_indicators.name: KPS Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current Karnofsky Performance Status score, tracked across recertification periods to document functional decline.

trend_indicators.name: Functional Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current functional/ADL dependence status, tracked across recertification periods to document progressive functional decline.

trend_indicators.name: Nutritional Trend
trend_indicators.description: Previous vs. current nutritional/hydration status, tracked across recertification periods to document progressive nutritional decline.

trend_indicators.name: Hospitalization Trend
trend_indicators.description: Frequency of hospitalization, tracked across recertification periods to document disease severity.

trend_indicators.name: Symptom Trend
trend_indicators.description: Frequency/severity of stroke/coma-related symptoms and complications (e.g. aspiration pneumonia, sepsis, pyelonephritis, pressure injury), tracked across recertification periods.

trend_indicators.name: Narrative Trend
trend_indicators.description: Free-text nurse narrative summarizing overall clinical decline across recertification periods, supporting but never replacing physician-supported prognosis determination.
